Step1BasicInfo.title: Configure basic information
Step1BasicInfo.description: Enter a window identification name and description. Identification names are used to distinguish different window configurations.
Step1BasicInfo.tagDesc: Used to uniquely identify this window configuration
Step1BasicInfo.tagHelper: Window name for your own identification.
Step1BasicInfo.descriptionDesc: Describe the purpose of this window configuration
Step1BasicInfo.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the purpose and functionality of this window

Step2HtmlConf.title: Configure HTML content
Step2HtmlConf.description: Specifies what the window displays. Web pages can be loaded via URL, or HTML code can be written directly.
Step2HtmlConf.urlDesc: The web page address or local URL to load
Step2HtmlConf.htmlDesc: Write HTML code directly (URL will be overridden if provided)
Step2HtmlConf.htmlHelper: Choose between URL and HTML code, provide at least one

Step3WindowType.title: Configure window specific options
Step3WindowType.description: Select window type and configuration type specific options.
Step3WindowType.windowTypeDesc: Float: floating window | Dialog: dialog box | System: system window
Step3WindowType.floatDesc: Floating windows can be dragged freely on the screen, suitable for real-time display of content
Step3WindowType.dialogDesc: The dialog box will be overlaid on top of other applications, suitable for important reminders
Step3WindowType.systemDesc: The system window is the window with the highest authority and is suitable for system-level functions.

Step4Advanced.title: Configure advanced options
Step4Advanced.description: These options usually have default values ​​and do not need to be modified. Adjust only when needed.
Step4Advanced.dismissTimeDesc: The time for the window to automatically close (milliseconds, 0 means not to close automatically)
Step4Advanced.dismissTimeHelper: Leave blank or fill in 0 to indicate that the window will not close automatically.
